REPORTED CREATION OF BUFFER STATE IN MONGOLIA.

10. 4/26/44
A.I.

Information has been received from a usually reliable
source to the effect that in the near future Inner
Mongolia will be turned into an independent buffer
State.

The creation of this new State was decided upon at
the last Conference of Soviet Russian, Outer Mongolian,
Manchukuoan and Japanese delegates at Chita, some time
this summer, which Conference came about as the
culmination of the peace discussions on the Nomonhan
Incident of 1939.

The forming of the new State is expected to put an
end to the countless border clashes which from time to
time have occurred between Russian and Japanese troops
and which ended in the great battle at the Nomonhan Hills.

Ataman Semenov is reported to have been designated
by the Japanese Military Authorities for the post of
High Commissioner for this new State.

Ataman Semenov is reported to be very active at
present in connection with his plans for the settling
of a large number of refugee Transbaikal Province
Cossacks from Manchukuo and elsewhere in order to
populate the territory of the new State.
pages.zh:
1940年9月11日
据报在蒙古建立缓冲国。

1944年4月26日 10时
A.I.

从通常可靠的消息来源获悉，内蒙古在不久的将来将被转变为一个独立的缓冲国。

建立这个新国家的决定是在今年夏季某个时候于赤塔举行的苏联俄罗斯、外蒙古、满洲国和日本代表最后一次会议上作出的，该会议是1939年诺门罕事件和平谈判的高潮。

预计新国家的建立将终结俄军和日军之间不时发生的无数边境冲突，这些冲突最终以诺门罕山的大战而告终。

据报道，日本军方当局已指定阿塔曼·谢苗诺夫（Ataman Semenov）担任这个新国家的高级专员。

据报道，阿塔曼·谢苗诺夫目前正积极着手其计划，旨在安置大量来自满洲国及其他地方的外贝加尔省哥萨克难民，以便为新国家的领土提供人口。

pages.en:
These people are to be given free lands and pastures
and will be afforded every facility including exemption
from every taxation. They are to form the nucleus of
the new Japanese puppet State.
The Japanese are very anxious to interest foreign
capital in the development of the new State.
pages.zh:
这些人将获得免费的土地和牧场，并享有包括免除一切税收在内的各种便利条件。他们将构成这个新的日本傀儡国家的核心。
日本人非常渴望吸引外国资本参与新国家的开发。
